title.zh: 将莱特省Palo的Kauswagan描笼涯中学的名称正式变更为Kauswagan国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Kauswagan Barangay High School in Palo, Leyte, to Kauswagan National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Kauswagan Barangay High School in Palo, Leyte, to Kauswagan National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Kauswagan Barangay High School in Palo, Leyte, thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Kauswagan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Kauswagan Barangay High School in Palo, Leyte, เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Kauswagan
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Kauswagan Barangay High School in Palo, Leyte, menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Kauswagan
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Kauswagan Barangay High School in Palo, Leyte, menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Kauswagan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6756_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Kauswagan Barangay High School in Palo, Leyte, is hereby changed to Kauswagan National High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
